control:
Package: enigma2-skin-fullhdglass17
Version: 9.50-r12.2
Description:  full hd glass 17
Section: base
Priority: optional
Maintainer: Shamann
Architecture: all
OE: enigma2-skin-fullhdglass17
Homepage: unknown
Depends: 
Source: None
postrm:
#!/bin/sh
# FullHDGlass17 9.50-r12 upgrade-safe postrm fix.
# On upgrade, the old package postrm can run after new files are unpacked.
# Never delete the newly installed skin in upgrade-family states.
case "${1:-}" in
    upgrade|failed-upgrade|abort-upgrade|disappear)
        exit 0
        ;;
esac
SCREENPATH=/usr/lib/enigma2/python/Screens
COMPPATH=/usr/lib/enigma2/python/Components
SKINPATH=/usr/share/enigma2/hd_glass17
PLUGINPATH=/usr/lib/enigma2/python/Plugins/Extensions/setupGlass17
echo "***************************************"
echo "Restoring original files ......"
[ -f /etc/enigma2/skin_user-ori.xml ] && cp -f /etc/enigma2/skin_user-ori.xml /etc/enigma2/skin_user.xml
[ -f /usr/share/enigma2/encoding-ori.conf ] && cp -f /usr/share/enigma2/encoding-ori.conf /usr/share/enigma2/encoding.conf
[ -f "$SCREENPATH/InfoBarGenerics-ori.py" ] && cp -f "$SCREENPATH/InfoBarGenerics-ori.py" "$SCREENPATH/InfoBarGenerics.py"
[ -f "$SCREENPATH/ChannelSelection-ori.py" ] && cp -f "$SCREENPATH/ChannelSelection-ori.py" "$SCREENPATH/ChannelSelection.py"
[ -f /usr/share/enigma2/keymap-ori.xml ] && cp -f /usr/share/enigma2/keymap-ori.xml /usr/share/enigma2/keymap.xml
[ -f "$SCREENPATH/Menu-orig17.py" ] && cp -f "$SCREENPATH/Menu-orig17.py" "$SCREENPATH/Menu.py"
[ -f "$SCREENPATH/Menu-orig17.pyo" ] && cp -f "$SCREENPATH/Menu-orig17.pyo" "$SCREENPATH/Menu.pyo"
[ -f "$SCREENPATH/Menu-orig17.pyc" ] && cp -f "$SCREENPATH/Menu-orig17.pyc" "$SCREENPATH/Menu.pyc"
echo "***************************************"
echo "Cleaning up ......"
rm -rf /usr/bin/btrGen /usr/bin/hdd_temp_hdg /usr/share/enigma2/encoding-ori.conf /etc/enigma2/skin_user-ori.xml /usr/share/enigma2/keymap-ori.xml
rm -rf -f $PLUGINPATH/*
rmdir "$PLUGINPATH" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf -f $COMPPATH/g17* $COMPPATH/*-new17.* $COMPPATH/*-orig.* $COMPPATH/Converter/g17* $COMPPATH/Renderer/g17*
rm -rf -f $SCREENPATH/g17* $SCREENPATH/*-new17.* $SCREENPATH/*-ori* $SCREENPATH/G17*
rm -rf -f $SKINPATH/*
rmdir "$SKINPATH" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Removing finished !"
echo "Please restart GUI to activate changes!"
exit 0
